title.ja: 図1-1 ツノ銀雁木の基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Horned Silver Gangi

explain.ja: 図1-1は、先手がツノ銀雁木に組んでいるところです。相手は矢倉囲いに組んでおり、この局面から先手がどう攻めるかを見ます。3七に桂馬が跳ねているのがポイントで、この桂馬が攻めの要になります。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 shows Black building Tsuno-gin Gangi while the opponent builds a Yagura. We see how Black attacks from this position. The key is the knight jumped to 3七, which becomes the pivot of the attack.

section.ja: ツノ銀雁木vs矢倉の基本形
section.en: Basic formation of Tsuno Silver Gangi vs Yagura

title.ja: 図2-1 角を引いて使う
title.en: Figure 2-1: Retreat and use the bishop

explain.ja: 図1-1から、まず角を引いて攻めに使う形を見ます。▲5六歩と突いておくことで、角を引いた後に角が動けるスペースを作ります。
explain.en: From Diagram 1-1, first see the form where the bishop is retreated and used in the attack. Pushing ▲5六歩 beforehand creates space for the bishop to move after it retreats.

section.en: Push the 5th-file pawn and retreat the bishop

title.ja: 図2-2 ▲4五歩からの攻めが基本
title.en: Figure 2-2: Attack starting with ▲4五歩 is basic

explain.ja: ▲4五歩から攻めるのが雁木の攻めの基本です。ここで桂馬を跳ねて相手の銀を狙います。▲3七桂と跳ねていた手が活きます。
explain.en: Attacking with ▲4五歩 is the basic Gangi attack. Then jump the knight to aim at the opponent's silver. The earlier knight jump to ▲3七桂 pays off.

explain.ja: 相手の銀が逃げたら、▲2四歩から角をさばきに行きます。角交換した後は▲2九飛と奥まで飛車を引いておきましょう。これで相手から角を打たれる隙がなく、こちらは▲7一角などの角打ちを狙えます。雁木は基本的に角打ちに強い陣形で、角交換に有利と覚えておきましょう。△4五銀と桂馬を取られても、▲4六歩で銀が死ぬので問題ありません。
explain.en: When the opponent's silver runs, start moving the bishop with ▲2四歩. After the bishop exchange, retreat the rook deep with ▲2九飛. That leaves no gap for the opponent to drop a bishop, while Black can aim for bishop drops such as ▲7一角. Gangi is basically strong against bishop drops and favorable in bishop exchanges. Even if the knight is captured by △4五銀, ▲4六歩 traps the silver, so it is fine.

section.ja: 角交換なら雁木が指しやすい
section.en: If bishops are exchanged, Gangi is easy to play

line.text: △4四銀、▲2四歩、△同歩、▲同角、△同角、▲同飛、△2三歩、▲2九飛

explain.ja: 図1-1に戻り、別の攻めを見ます。今度は相手が矢倉囲いをがっちり固めるまでこちらも陣形を固め、▲6五歩として角のラインを開けます。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 1-1 and see another attack. This time Black also firms up its formation until the opponent has solidified the Yagura, then opens the bishop line with ▲6五歩. Strengthening further with ▲8八玉 and ▲6八金 is also possible.

section.ja: 相手の矢倉囲いの完成を待ち、角道を開ける
section.en: Wait for the opponent to finish the Yagura, then open the bishop diagonal

line.text: △7四歩、▲5六歩、△7三銀、▲7九玉、△3一玉、▲2九飛、△2二玉、▲6五歩

title.ja: 図3-2 やはり▲4五歩から仕掛ける

explain.ja: 相手は△7五歩から攻めてきますが、構わずこちらも▲4五歩と仕掛けます。この局面では、あらかじめ▲2九飛と引いておいたおかげで、△3九角成の手を消していることにも注目です。
explain.en: The opponent attacks with △7五歩, but Black ignores it and attacks with ▲4五歩. Note that because the rook was retreated to ▲2九飛 beforehand, the move △3九角成 is eliminated.

section.ja: ▲4五歩から、3筋と2筋の歩も切る
section.en: From ▲4五歩, also cut the 3rd and 2nd file pawns

explain.ja: ▲4五桂と跳ねたいところですが、その前に2筋と3筋の歩も切ります。一見狙いがわかりにくいですが、さらに進めます。
explain.en: Black wants to jump the knight to ▲4五桂, but first sacrifices the 2nd- and 3rd-file pawns. The aim is unclear at first, so continue.

section.ja: ▲4五歩から、3筋と2筋の歩も切る
section.en: From ▲4五歩, also cut the 3rd and 2nd file pawns

title.ja: 図3-4 角を切って十字飛車
title.en: Figure 3-4: Sacrifice the bishop for a cross-shaped rook

explain.ja: ▲4五桂、△4四銀に対して、▲同角と角を切る手が成立します。▲2四飛と走れば王手金取りで、先手勝勢です。角を切らずに▲2四飛から▲4四飛と飛車を切る手もありますが、雁木は角打ちに強く飛車打ちに弱い陣形なので良い手ではありません。この攻め筋は居角左美濃急戦でも見られますが、左美濃は飛車打ちに強く角に弱い陣形なので、飛車を切る順が指されます。
explain.en: After ▲4五桂 △4四銀, sacrificing the bishop with ▲同角 works. Then running ▲2四飛 gives check and attacks a gold, and Black is winning. Sacrificing the rook with ▲2四飛 and ▲4四飛 instead of the bishop is possible, but Gangi is strong against bishop drops and weak against rook drops, so it isn't a good move. This attack also appears in the Left Mino rapid attack with an unmoved bishop, but since Left Mino is strong against rook drops and weak against bishops, the rook-sacrifice line is played there.

section.ja: 最後は十字飛車で勝勢に
section.en: Finish with a cross rook for a winning position

title.ja: 図4-1 右四間飛車に構える
title.en: Figure 4-1: Set up Right Fourth File Rook

explain.ja: 図1-1に戻り、最後は右四間飛車の攻め筋を見ます。▲5六銀と腰掛け銀に構えて飛車を4筋に回るのが右四間飛車の陣形です。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 1-1; last, the Right Fourth File Rook attack. The formation sets the silver as a Reclining Silver with ▲5六銀 and swings the rook to the 4th file.

section.en: Set up Right Fourth File Rook

line.text: △7四歩、▲5六銀、△7三銀、▲7九玉、△3一玉、▲4八飛

title.ja: 図4-2 角道を開けて▲4五歩
title.en: Figure 4-2: Open the bishop diagonal and ▲4五歩

explain.ja: ▲6五歩と角道を開けてから▲4五歩と仕掛けます。▲1六歩と突く手は、どこかで△1五角と出られる手を消しています。△1五角と出られる順は右四間飛車の弱点なので、しっかり対処しておきましょう。
explain.en: Open the bishop line with ▲6五歩 and then attack with ▲4五歩. The move ▲1六歩 removes the possibility of △1五角 at some point. Lines where △1五角 comes out are a weakness of Right Fourth File Rook, so deal with them carefully.

section.en: The attack starts with ▲4五歩 after all

line.text: △2二玉、▲6五歩、△1四歩、▲1六歩、△6四歩、▲4五歩

title.ja: 図4-3 攻めの後続手はないか？
title.en: Figure 4-3: Is there a follow-up attack?

explain.ja: 図4-3は▲4五桂と跳ねた局面です。▲4四銀で攻めがなくなっているように見えますが、後続手はないでしょうか。
explain.en: Diagram 4-3 is the position after the knight jump ▲4五桂. After ▲4四銀 the attack seems to have run out; is there a follow-up?

section.ja: 角を切って攻めが続く
section.en: Sacrifice the bishop and the attack continues

title.ja: 図4-4 角を切って攻めを続ける
title.en: Figure 4-4: Sacrifice the bishop and continue the attack

explain.ja: 図4-3から角を切って攻める順がありました。これで雁木側が優勢になります。雁木は陣形のバランスが良く角に強いので、角を切って攻めても反動が怖くありません。
explain.en: From Diagram 4-3 there is a line sacrificing the bishop to attack. This gives the Gangi side the advantage. Gangi is well balanced and strong against bishops, so sacrificing the bishop in the attack carries little fear of a counterattack.

section.ja: 角を切って攻めが続く
section.en: Sacrifice the bishop and the attack continues
